## Primary Expertise & Tech Stack
- **Mobile Development:** Flutter, Dart, iOS, Android, Clean Architecture, BLoC/Provider
- **Web Development:** Drupal, PHP, Web APIs
- **Smart Home & Systems:** Home Assistant, Python, Microcontrollers (ESPHome), MQTT, Docker, Linux

## Open Source Projects
- [xras_magnetic_storm](https://github.com/Alangasar/xras_magnetic_storm) — Home Assistant integration providing current and forecast geomagnetic activity (Kp-index) data from xras.ru. Covers 146 cities across Russia and Europe.
- [myschoolcard](https://github.com/Alangasar/myschoolcard) — Home Assistant integration for the myschoolcard.ru school card service.
- [dm](https://github.com/alangasar/dm) — Symfony var-dumper wrapper for Drupal 8.
